milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted cactus is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 4) on top of the oak plank platform directly ahead of spawn. The player must navigate near it and face it to 'find' it. max_distance=5 is appropriate since the cactus is 4 blocks from spawn at eye level — the player can trigger this from near-spawn if looking directly at it, which correctly models 'finding' a prominent object. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the cactus.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The heavy weighted pressure plate is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 9) inside the back alcove behind the potted cactus. max_distance=4 (tightened per ValidatorAgent suggestion) ensures the player must be inside or at the entrance of the alcove (doorway at z=7 is 2 blocks from plate at z=9, well within range). The alcove walls at z=7 prevent triggering from the main room unless the player has navigated through the doorway past the cactus. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the floor-level pressure plate.
